premise.place: a theme park for retired algorithms
premise.text: a suspiciously polite supervillain at a theme park for retired algorithms, dealing with a toaster with diplomatic immunity

contestants.model: dry, compact, understated jokes with a hard final turn
surreal but readable jokes with strange concrete images
character-forward jokes with setup, escalation, and clean punchline
language-driven jokes, reversals, and neat phrase twists
light roast energy aimed at objects and situations, not people

jokes.label: Joke A
jokes.title: Guest Relations
jokes.setup: At a theme park for retired algorithms, a suspiciously polite supervillain tried to intimidate a toaster with diplomatic immunity.
jokes.punchline: By noon, he had conquered three gift shops and issued a written apology to the toaster's embassy.
jokes.text: At a theme park for retired algorithms, a suspiciously polite supervillain tried to intimidate a toaster with diplomatic immunity. By noon, he had conquered three gift shops and issued a written apology to the toaster's embassy.

jokes.label: Joke B
jokes.title: The Toast Accord
jokes.setup: The retired algorithms rode the carousel in perfect silence while the diplomatic toaster negotiated with a suspiciously polite supervillain.
jokes.punchline: Every time the carousel stopped, another horse became legally bread-adjacent.
jokes.text: The retired algorithms rode the carousel in perfect silence while the diplomatic toaster negotiated with a suspiciously polite supervillain. Every time the carousel stopped, another horse became legally bread-adjacent.

jokes.label: Joke C
jokes.title: FastPass Incident
jokes.setup: The supervillain objected when the toaster skipped the line at the retired-algorithm roller coaster.
jokes.punchline: Security waved it through because its passport had more stamps than his entire evil plan.
jokes.text: The supervillain objected when the toaster skipped the line at the retired-algorithm roller coaster. Security waved it through because its passport had more stamps than his entire evil plan.

jokes.label: Joke D
jokes.title: Toast Of The Treaty
jokes.setup: The supervillain announced a hostile takeover of the theme park, starting with the toaster's diplomatic suite.
jokes.punchline: The toaster said international law required all takeovers to be lightly browned.
jokes.text: The supervillain announced a hostile takeover of the theme park, starting with the toaster's diplomatic suite. The toaster said international law required all takeovers to be lightly browned.

jokes.label: Joke E
jokes.title: Free Trial Villainy
jokes.setup: At the retired-algorithm theme park, the supervillain threatened a toaster that had diplomatic immunity.
jokes.punchline: The toaster replied, 'Bold words from a guy whose master plan still has a free trial watermark.'
jokes.text: At the retired-algorithm theme park, the supervillain threatened a toaster that had diplomatic immunity. The toaster replied, 'Bold words from a guy whose master plan still has a free trial watermark.'
